name: PlusPrice
author: themeshape

sections.description:
It’s about time for a live page builder, with no limits of design. A page builder that delivers high-end pricing table designs and advanced capabilities, never before seen on WordPress.

2.0.0

(05 April, 2026)

  • Updated compatibility with Elementor 3.25+ and WordPress 6.9
  • Replaced deprecated elementor/widgets/widgets_registered hook with elementor/widgets/register
  • Replaced deprecated register_widget_type() with register()
  • Fixed namespace references for Group_Control_Typography, Group_Control_Box_Shadow, and Group_Control_Border
  • Replaced deprecated Font Awesome alignment icons with Elementor native icons
  • Removed deprecated show_external option from URL controls
  • Fixed wp_enqueue_style calls with proper dependency parameter
  • Fixed XSS vulnerability by escaping feature list output
  • Minimum PHP version raised to 7.4
  • Minimum Elementor version raised to 3.5.0
  • Minimum WordPress version raised to 6.0

1.0.2

(26 November, 2022)

  • Elementor Compatiblity issue fixed
  • WordPress Version 6.1.1 Compatiblity Checking

1.0.0

(2020-04-05)

  • Initial Public Release

short_description: This plugin for elementor builder addons. Create high-end, pixel perfect pricing table. Any theme, any page, any design.
